description.value: Coast Tsawwassen Inn is a contemporary, suite-style hotel operated by the regional Coast Hotels chain, positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal — a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing to Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands. Rooms feature mini fridges, microwaves, and free wi-fi, and the property includes a fitness centre and on-site Browns Socialhouse restaurant. The hotel offers free parking and free electric vehicle charging stations on site.

address.value: 1665 56 Street, Delta, British Columbia V4L 2B2 Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an active, open hotel at 1665 56 Street, Delta, BC. Phone (604.943.8221) and address match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or bike-specific amenities anywhere in the site content; however, free wi-fi is explicitly confirmed, on-site Browns Socialhouse confirms nearby evening food, and the free continental breakfast starting at 6am on weekdays qualifies as an early breakfast option for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel near the Tsawwassen ferry terminal — a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the BC ferry routes.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website mentions free electric car charging stations on site; this could support e-bike charging but is not specific enough to confirm — marked null pending direct verification.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Free continental breakfast served from 6am Monday–Friday and 6:30am weekends/holidays in the hotel lobby
